headline: Nvidia Shatters Records with Blockbuster Earnings Report
body: Nvidia (NVDA) reported fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter earnings of $1.62 per share (+82.0% year over year) on revenue of $68.1 billion (+73.2% YoY), crushing Wall Street expectations. The AI chip giant guided to fiscal 2027 first-quarter revenue of $78.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, as demand for AI computing continues to surge. Data center revenue climbed 75% from a year earlier to $62.3 billion, cementing Nvidia's dominance in the AI infrastructure market. Shares jumped over 7% in after-hours trading, extending the year-to-date rally.

headline: Axon Soars on Record-Breaking AI-Driven Growth
body: Shares of Axon Enterprise (NASDAQ: AXON) surged more than 18% in early trading on Wednesday, February 25, 2026, following a fourth-quarter earnings report that shattered Wall Street's expectations. The public safety technology giant reported 39% revenue growth from a year ago, with net income totaling about $3 million, or 3 cents per share. CEO Rick Smith highlighted that AI for the company 'will create value that our customers simply cannot replicate,' as the company's AI-driven public safety ecosystem continues to gain traction across law enforcement agencies.

headline: Meta Partners with AMD for Massive AI Chip Deal
body: Meta Platforms (META) announced a landmark agreement with Advanced Micro Devices to provide the Facebook and Instagram parent with up to $60 billion worth of AI chips over five years. The deal, which allows Meta to purchase as much as 10% of AMD's chip production, sent AMD shares soaring more than 6% while Meta's stock gained 2.3%. The partnership strengthens Meta's AI computing capabilities as it races to build out data centers for AI training and inference, positioning the company to better compete with rivals in the AI arms race.

headline: Apple Shatters Records with Q4 Performance and Strong 2026 Outlook
body: Apple (AAPL) delivered blockbuster fourth-quarter results, with revenue growing 12% year over year to $124.3 billion, driven by strong iPhone 16 sales and record services revenue. The tech giant announced plans to expand its domestic production network, which could benefit shareholders through potential tax incentives and supply chain resilience. Despite broader market volatility, Apple's stock gained 1.8% on the news, as investors bet on the company's AI integration strategy and robust cash flow generation.

headline: Tesla Faces Mounting Headwinds Despite Tech Sector Rally
body: Tesla (TSLA) struggled to keep pace with the broader tech sector rally, with shares down 1.2% amid mounting challenges including production delays at the Berlin Gigafactory and increased competition in the EV market. The company's stock has shed approximately 7% of its value since the start of the year, as investors grow concerned about near-term cash flow and capital expenditure requirements. However, analysts note that Tesla's energy storage business continues to show strong growth, providing a potential offset to automotive segment weakness.

headline: S&P 500 Powers Higher on Tech Strength and Nvidia Catalyst
body: The S&P 500 (SPY) posted strong gains Wednesday, February 25, 2026, as technology shares led the market higher ahead of Nvidia's highly anticipated earnings report. The index gained 1.8%, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite rising 2.3%, as investors positioned for what many consider the most critical earnings report of the season. The rally was broad-based, with all 11 S&P 500 sectors finishing in positive territory, suggesting improving market breadth and renewed investor confidence in the AI-driven growth narrative.
